sources.title: lilcheaty/MiniMax-H3-NVFP4 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: H3 was trained on the structured output of H3-Context-IR, a preprocessing model that rewrites a plain request into labelled sections; MiniMax's model card calls it "critical to the quality of the final output". ComfyUI passes your raw string straight to the DiT, so you must write that structure yourself. Official guides: base · ref
